first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence suggests that shorter onboarding and simpler signup can improve early adoption. I would verify these related records plus activation-messaging evidence before committing, then run a small guarded test that monitors qualified activation, downstream product usage, retention, and revenue—not just completion. This addresses the current funnel deterioration without immediately sacrificing sustainable revenue through broad discounting.

final.rationale: Run a controlled simplification of onboarding this week because completion is down 4% and the verified shortened-flow experiment improved completion, reduced time-to-value, and increased 30-day retention. Measure qualified activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue—not completion alone. Guard against the small retention decline previously observed with broader signup simplification by limiting changes to onboarding and segmenting results, with automatic rollback if downstream retention or qualified revenue deteriorates.
